# Code Review: Blog Website Application

## Review scope

Reviewed the implementation in `public/index.html`, `public/styles.css`, and
`public/app.js` against `artifacts/requirements.md`,
`artifacts/architecture.md`, and `artifacts/design-review.md`.

## Findings

### Low — Modal does not keep keyboard focus inside the dialog

`openModal()` moves focus to the title field and the dialog supports Escape and
focus restoration on close. However, keyboard users can Tab from the modal to
controls in the page behind it even though the dialog declares `aria-modal="true"`.
Consider trapping focus within the dialog, or use a native `<dialog>` with
appropriate focus management.

## Evaluation

| Area | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Correctness | Blog list, article details, create flow, content-based summary generation, and localStorage persistence are implemented. Title and content are trimmed, required, and length-checked before save. Generated summaries are saved with the article. |
| Security | Blog data is rendered with `textContent` and DOM element APIs, avoiding interpretation of stored/user-provided article text as HTML. No external AI service, database, or authentication dependency was introduced. Admin actions are intentionally a local UI workflow, not an access-control boundary. |
| Error handling | Storage reads, initialization writes, and saves handle unavailable storage. The UI displays a notice on persistence failure and does not report a failed save as successful. Invalid stored data is handled with a visible notice. |
| Code clarity | Client logic is organized into small functions for storage, validation, summary generation, and rendering. The client-side summary is deterministic and based on the article text, consistent with the approved self-contained design. |
| DRY principle | Shared text-element creation and summary generation are reused for list excerpts and article details. Limits are defined once in the client and also enforced by HTML input attributes. |

## Requirement and design alignment

- Visitors can view blog titles and open full article details.
- Users can create posts after title/content validation.
- The Generate Summary action creates a deterministic, content-based summary.
- Posts and their summaries are saved in browser localStorage.
- The app remains a lightweight Express-served frontend with no external database
  or third-party AI dependency.
- Responsive layouts are provided for narrower screens.
- Local browser storage is not shared across browsers or devices, and the create
  workflow is not protected by authentication; both limitations are documented
  in the approved design.

## Review outcome

No blocking correctness or security findings. The keyboard focus-trapping
improvement is non-blocking. The under-three-second performance target was not
measured as part of this source review.

## Validation

No application run or tests were performed as part of this review.
